name: ListStackResourceDrifts

parameters.help_en: The physical ID of the resource
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the resource drift detection operation was initiated
parameters.help_zh:
使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The resource properties as defined in the template, in JSON format
parameters.help_zh:
资源偏差状态。取值：
DELETED：资源与预期的模板配置不同，因为资源已被删除。
MODIFIED：资源与预期的模板配置不同。
NOT_CHECKED：ROS没有检查资源是否与预期的模板配置不同。
IN_SYNC：资源的当前配置与其预期的模板配置相匹配
parameters.name: resource_drift_status

NextToken.description_en: The query token returned in this call
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值

ActualProperties.description_zh: 实际的资源属性，以JSON格式表示

DriftDetectionTime.description_en: The time when the drift detection operation was performed on the resource

ExpectedProperties.description_en: The JSON-formatted resource properties that are defined in the template
ExpectedProperties.description_zh: 模板中定义的资源属性，以JSON格式表示

LogicalResourceId.description_en: The logical ID of the resource. The logical ID indicates the name of the resource that is defined in the template
LogicalResourceId.description_zh: 资源逻辑ID，即模板中资源的名称

ModuleInfo.description_en: The information about the modules from which the resource was created. This parameter is returned only if the resource is created from modules
ModuleInfo.description_zh: 资源来源模块的信息。如果资源来自于模块，才返回该字段

LogicalIdHierarchy.description_en:
The concatenated logical IDs of one or more modules that contain the resource. The modules are listed from the outermost layer and separated by forward slashes (`/`).

In the following example, the resource is created from Module B nested within Parent Module A:

`moduleA/moduleB`
LogicalIdHierarchy.description_zh:
包含资源的一个或多个模块的逻辑ID的串联列表。 模块从最外层开始列出，并以 `/`分隔。

在以下示例中，资源是从嵌套在父模块moduleA中的模块moduleB创建的。

`moduleA/moduleB`

TypeHierarchy.description_en:
The concatenated types of one or more modules that contain the resource. The module types are listed from the outermost layer and separated by forward slashes (`/`).

In the following example, the resource is created from a module of the `MODULE::ROS::Child::Example` type that is nested within a parent module of the `MODULE::ROS::Parent::Example` type:

`MODULE::ROS::Parent::Example/MODULE::ROS::Child::Example`
TypeHierarchy.description_zh:
包含资源的一个或多个模块类型的串联列表。 模块类型从最外层开始列出，并以 `/`分隔。

在以下示例中，资源是从`MODULE::ROS::Child::Example`类型的模块创建的，该模块嵌套在`MODULE::ROS::Parent::Example`类型的父模块中。

`MODULE::ROS::Parent::Example/MODULE::ROS::Child::Example`

PhysicalResourceId.description_en: The physical ID of the resource

PropertyDifferences.description_en: The property drifts of the resource

ActualValue.description_en: The actual value of the resource property

DifferenceType.description_en:
The drift type of the resource property. Valid values:

ADD: The value is added to a resource property whose data type is Array or List.

REMOVE: The property is deleted from the current resource configuration.

NOT_EQUAL: The current property value differs from the expected value that is defined in the stack template
DifferenceType.description_zh:
资源属性的偏差类型。取值：
ADD：已将值添加到数据类型为数组或列表的资源属性。
REMOVE：属性已从当前资源配置中删除。
NOT_EQUAL：当前属性值与堆栈模板中定义的预期值不同

ExpectedValue.description_en: The expected value of the resource property that is defined in the template

PropertyPath.description_en: The path of the resource property

ResourceDriftStatus.description_en:
The drift state of the resource. Valid values:

DELETED: The actual configuration of the resource differs from its expected template configuration because the resource is deleted.

MODIFIED: The actual configuration of the resource differs from its expected template configuration.

NOT_CHECKED: Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) has not checked whether the actual configuration of the resource differs from its expected template configuration.

IN_SYNC: The actual configuration of the resource matches its expected template configuration
ResourceDriftStatus.description_zh:
资源偏差状态。取值：
DELETED：资源与预期的模板配置不同，因为资源已被删除。
MODIFIED：资源与预期的模板配置不同。
NOT_CHECKED：ROS没有检查资源是否与预期的模板配置不同。
IN_SYNC：资源的当前配置与其预期的模板配置相匹配
